description: Draw a Rust map from a public .map file URL, or generate one from a procedural seed + size. ASYNCHRONOUS: returns a job (job_id + status). If the map already exists you get it straight away; otherwise the job is queued for the background drawer - call get_map_job with the job_id after ~20-60 s (a seed generation takes 6-10 minutes). Use get_server_map / get_map first: most live servers' maps are already drawn. Keyless callers share a small daily budget and can only use url (seed generation needs your own free API key from https://rust.wiki/api-keys).

seed.description: Procedural map seed (32-bit). Use with size.

size.description: Procedural map size in metres (1000-6000). Use with seed.

url.description: Public https:// link to a Rust .map file.

name: create_map
title: Ask for a Rust map to be drawn (asynchronous)
